methodology.pe: Sector P/E = Σ MarketCap / Σ NetIncome; loss-making companies (NetIncome ≤ 0) excluded from both numerator and denominator.
methodology.pb: Sector P/B = Σ MarketCap / Σ TotalEquity (year-end equity).
methodology.roe: Sector ROE = Σ NetIncome / Σ TotalEquity, year-end balances. Pooled — may differ from IndianAPI per-company ROE, which uses average balances. This divergence is intentional.
methodology.roa: Sector ROA = Σ NetIncome / Σ TotalAssets, year-end balances. Pooled — may differ from IndianAPI per-company ROA (average balances). Intentional.
methodology.roce: Sector ROCE = Σ OperatingIncome / Σ (TotalEquity + TotalDebt). OperatingIncome (== EBIT) is taken directly from IndianAPI; EBIT is NOT reconstructed from EBITDA − D&A when OperatingIncome exists. Not meaningful for lenders — Banking & Finance ROCE is '—'.
methodology.eps_growth: Sector EPS growth = market-cap-weighted average of each constituent's YoY diluted-EPS growth (latest vs prior FY).
methodology.piotroski: Sector Piotroski = simple average of constituents' Piotroski F-scores (0-9). Not computed for lenders (banks/NBFCs lack the current-asset / cost-of-revenue structure the score assumes).
methodology.peg: Sector PEG = Sector P/E / pooled earnings-growth %, only when earnings growth is positive.
methodology.period: All aggregates use the latest annual period common to the constituents. Values are ₹ crore from the statement map.
methodology.units: Absolute values are ₹ crore from financials[].stockFinancialMap and marketCap. keyMetrics is used only for ratios.
